name: @mcpgen/spec-converter
description: Node helper that normalizes non-OpenAPI-3.x API specs (Swagger 2.0, Swagger 1.x, Postman 2.x) to OpenAPI 3.0 JSON. Called as a subprocess from the Python engine's Stage A. Stays out of the pnpm workspace so its CommonJS-heavy deps don't pollute the rest of the monorepo.
